sentence: This project tests whether problems with spatial navigation are an early sign of cognitive decline in aging adults with Down syndrome.
This project builds and tests a single-session treatment with follow-up chatbot support for domestic violence survivors with posttraumatic stress disorder and depression.
This project studies how motoneuron excitability goes wrong in a mouse model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal lobar degeneration dementia.
This project develops technologies that help find cancer early at the point-of-care in places with limited medical resources.
This project acquires a high-performance computing engine to speed up research such as vaccine design, disease gene analysis and drug discovery.
This project tries to find out what a cellular protein does and why it is required for influenza virus infection.
This project studies how genetic sex and aging affect cardiac inflammation, atrial fibrillation and dementia, and tests fibrosis inhibition as a preventive therapy.
This project makes tools for magnetic resonance imaging of children that make the scan quieter and correct for head movement.
This project develops machine learning techniques to detect rapid adaptation in the genomes of mosquitoes.
This project tests whether disrupting an endogenous brake on mitochondrial metabolism helps T cells fight cancer, using mouse models and human cells.
This project tries to find out why fat cells stop working properly in obesity.
This project explores a nucleic acid platform that can control immunostimulation and adjust therapeutic responses.
This project holds a conference on induced pluripotent stem cell technology and its uses in disease modeling, drug discovery and cell-based therapy.
This project studies how bacteria use memory and gene regulation to survive nutrient starvation and antibiotics.
This project builds statistical methods to understand how genes are regulated and how differences in the transcriptome affect cells.
This project uses high throughput genomics assays and CRISPR to find how genetic variants change regulatory elements and 3D genome organization.
This project tries to find out how bacteriophages break through the barrier of a biofilm.
This project uses genomics and health care data to define blood pressure markers that help manage hypertension in young adults.
This project investigates what a signaling molecule does in the cells that form early heart valve structures in mouse embryos, using two mouse models.
